name: Crema
description: Crema is a small Node.js LAN messenger for always-on displays. It serves a PWA, a display view, settings, history, and logs over HTTP.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent Crema runtime state: replies, shortcuts, Do Not Disturb state, history database, and event logs.

ports.name: Web/PWA Port
ports.description: Port used to access the Crema PWA, display, settings, history, and logs.

ports.name: Embedded Broker Port
ports.description: Socket.IO broker port. Other Crema peers can connect to ws://unraid-ip:[PORT].

variables.name: Owner Name
variables.description: Display name for this Crema instance. Set a unique owner name for each peer.

variables.name: Transport
variables.description: Transport mode: broker, dual, or p2p. Broker is recommended for Docker because it avoids .local/mDNS peer resolution.

variables.name: Embed Broker
variables.description: Start Crema's lightweight broker inside this container.

variables.name: Broker URL
variables.description: Socket.IO broker URL used by this Crema app. Keep ws://127.0.0.1:4000 to use the embedded broker.

variables.name: Advertise Broker via mDNS
variables.description: Advertise this broker as _crema-broker._tcp via mDNS. Keep 0 for Docker and set other peers to ws://unraid-ip:4000 explicitly.

variables.name: Allow P2P with Embedded Broker
variables.description: Set to 1 only if you want embedded-broker containers to use dual/p2p mDNS discovery. Keep 0 for Docker.

variables.name: Resolve mDNS Addresses
variables.description: In p2p/dual mode, prefer IPv4 addresses returned by mDNS over .local hostnames. Set to 0 to use hostname-only mDNS resolution.

variables.name: Broker Token
variables.description: Optional shared token. Must match the Crema Broker token when broker authentication is enabled.

variables.name: Latitude
variables.description: Latitude used for the display day/night theme schedule.

variables.name: Longitude
variables.description: Longitude used for the display day/night theme schedule.
